overview.about: The Weeknd's After Hours til Dawn was one of the biggest tours of the 2020s - a stadium production built on the dystopian staging of his After Hours and Dawn FM albums. This entry marks his hometown show at the Rogers Centre in Toronto on the 2025 North American leg, with Playboi Carti and Mike Dean supporting.
overview.nextEvent: No further edition of this show is scheduled - the After Hours til Dawn stadium run has concluded. The Weeknd has since signalled a move away from the persona, so a future tour would likely be a new production.
